extraction.title_en: Announcement on Planning a Major Asset Restructuring and Signing an Equity Acquisition Intent Agreement (Preliminary)
extraction.summary_en: Wuhan Mingde Biotechnology (002932) signed an equity acquisition intent agreement on 29 December 2025 with Lanfan Medical (蓝帆医疗), a Shenzhen-listed company, to acquire 100% of Wuhan Bikaier Rescue Supplies Co., Ltd. for cash. The deal is preliminarily expected to constitute a major asset restructuring under CSRC rules, is not a related-party transaction, and will not change the controlling shareholder or actual controller. The agreement is a non-binding framework; pricing will be based on a future third-party valuation, and the company must complete due diligence and approvals before a formal agreement is signed. Lanfan Medical is bound by an exclusivity commitment through 28 February 2026, and the filing emphasizes substantial uncertainty over whether the transaction will be completed.
